name: DELTA110
description:
## Description

"Built-in DAC preamplifier with digital input.The D/A converter uses a full differential mode bit stream method.The D/A converter uses two Philips SAA7321 bit stream DACs for each channel and operates in differential mode.The Arkham custom IC is used for the digital signal processing before it is input to the converter and is specially shaped to eliminate the nonlinearity of the D/A converter almost completely and to increase the signal-to-noise ratio.The custom IC greatly reduces digital noise generation by replacing all conventional ICs with the custom IC, and the noise level is reduced by applying special noise countermeasures only found in military electronics.The D/A converter circuit is automatically turned off when an analog input is used.The D/A converter circuit was built on a plug-in type single board and was designed to be replaced and upgraded when the converter circuit was improved.It is equipped with an absolute phase switch.Some CDs reproduced from an old analog record are inverted in phase. This type of CD is also supported by inverting the phase using the absolute phase switch.Phase inversion is processed digitally by Arkham's custom IC.Signal switching is performed by a contact-sealed relay located immediately behind the input / output terminals, which shortens the signal path as much as possible and reduces noise and distortion.In addition, the contact-sealed relay has less corrosion over time than the conventional open switch, and enables high-purity transmission.Equipped with feedback loop balance control.This simplifies the signal path and reduces noise and distortion.The power supply circuit is equipped with dedicated toroidal power transformers for digital and analog circuits respectively.In addition, 12 separate stabilized power supply circuits are installed to provide a stable voltage supply to each circuit and to suppress noise as much as possible.In the DELTA110, only the input selector switch performs both functions, whereas in conventional preamplifiers, the playback selector and the recording selector were provided separately.When the green LED above the input switch lights up, the playback source (Listen) can be switched, and when the red LED lights up, the recording source (Record) can be switched.This simplifies internal wiring and switches.Wireless remote control is included."

name: DELTA120
description:
## Description

"A stereo power amplifier that can also be used as a monaural power amplifier in bridge mode.It can be used as a monaural power amplifier in bridge mode by switching the switch on the rear panel.It can also be used as a monaural mode by switching the other switch, which can be used to drive a bi-amplifier system.The power supply is equipped with an independent toroidal transformer, capacitor and rectifier circuit for each of the left and right channels to eliminate interference between the channels.A large output current with a peak value of ¥25A is obtained by using a large toroidal power transformer and a Low ESR capacitor. This makes it possible to drive the speaker accurately in the low frequency range and even drive the speaker with low impedance.A high-speed electronic protection circuit is mounted as a protection circuit.In the event of a problem, the output relay operates to cut off the speaker output. name: DELTABLACKBOX
description:
## Description

"D/A converter for 48 kHz.Uses Arkham custom IC.Many D/A converters use several ICs in the digital processing part, so the rise time of the digital signal is faster, acting like an antenna between the circuit trace and the IC, and generating high-frequency noise.Arkham's custom-designed ICs replace all of these ICs and the wires connected to them, eliminating the biggest source of noise.The D/A converter IC is specially selected and manufactured by Philips.The analog filter has a fully discrete configuration and has excellent noise characteristics compared to filters composed of IC amplifiers.The power supply employs an independent transformer and seven independent regulators for analog and digital circuits, ensuring a stable power supply.In addition, the star earth system minimizes power supply noise.Aluminum is used for the whole case to suppress external vibration that adversely affects sound.In addition, the D/A converter board is fixed to the sorbose vibration damper.Two digital inputs are provided : coaxial and optical.Sampling frequencies of 44.1 kHz and 48 kHz are also available for connection with DAT devices."

description:
## Description

"D/A converter using 1-bit method.Uses Arkham custom IC.The D/A converter uses several ICs in the digital processing part, so the rise time of the digital signal is faster, and it acts like an antenna between the circuit trace and the IC, causing high frequency noise.Arkham's custom-designed ICs take the place of these ICs and the wires connected to all ICs, eliminating the biggest source of noise.The D/A conversion section uses a 1-bit D/A converter using two Philips SAA7321 s.A custom IC developed by Arkham Co., Ltd. traces the required signal process in separate mode to reduce distortion and improve linearity at low levels.The analog filter uses an operational amplifier IC for measuring instruments and is designed with a high-speed DC coupling.The power supply is equipped with independent transformers for analog and digital circuits and uses seven independent regulators.The star ground system minimizes power supply ground noise.It was designed to upgrade hardware.The printed circuit board of the D/A converter is designed to be interchangeable so that the board can be easily replaced in the future when converter technology advances.There was a wood case as an option sold separately."
